title: Share helpers on an interface without adding implementation requirements
goal: Use non-virtual static interface helpers when a contract owns shared implementation code and callers need one fixed implementation without adding duties for implementing types.

selectionNotes: Call helpers on the declaring interface, not through an instance or implementing class.
The helper surface already works on .NET 10; C# 15 removes a gate for runtimes without default interface methods. No legacy route is advertised.

prerequisites: Target net11.0 with LangVersion 15.0 and implicit usings enabled; use the supplied System.Globalization import and namespace.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared net11.0 sample using its matching reference assemblies and C# 15 compiler.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This edition targets net11.0. Ordinary static interface helpers already work on .NET 10; runtime 11 is not their original introduction.

language.name: C#
language.reason: C# 15 stabilizes the removal of the default-interface-method runtime gate; the helper syntax itself predates this release.

stabilityLimitations: Verified using .NET 11 RC2 artifacts only; GA reconciliation is pending.
constraints: Use a body on a non-virtual static helper. Implementers supply only the instance contract.
Public helpers are called on the declaring interface; private helpers remain implementation details.
Static abstract and static virtual members are separate dispatch contracts, not fixed helpers.
Preserve an existing public companion method or plan a breaking API migration when relocating it.
No .NET Framework/netstandard or newer-SDK/older-target route is declared or verified.

sources.title: Roslyn 83097: non-virtual static interface members without DIM runtime support

evidence.scope: Original companion utility: invariant station labels, blank/negative rejection and an implementer providing only Station. Exact saved record covers these actual executions; consumer compiler checks run separately in eng/Verify.ps1.

Original static interface helper: identical label and validation rules; real method metadata is static, non-abstract and non-virtual. Separate consumer builds/execution and access/dispatch rejection checks run in eng/Test-StaticInterfaceHelpers.ps1; no legacy-runtime or GA proof is claimed.

humanProof.scope: Portable declared-target compiler and helper behavior is covered by actual builds and executions. No native UI or legacy runtime route is claimed.
